security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG translates vkeccak.vi with data-dependent execution latency (e.g., early-exit loop on imm5==0, conditional branches dependent on Keccak state bits, or non-constant-time host rotate instructions), violating the DIEL mandate that execution time must be independent of input data
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: data-dependent control flow in cryptographic instruction translation, variable-latency host ops on keccak state, non-constant-time rotate/ shift by input-dependent amounts
security_spec.summary: Zvknhk vkeccak.vi mandates data-independent execution latency; TCG translation with input-dependent branches or variable-latency host ops leaks guest cryptographic state via cross-VM timing side channels

findings.finding: Zvknhk (vkeccak.vi) is not implemented in this QEMU tree. The security spec condition (DIEL violation via data-dependent execution latency in vkeccak.vi TCG translation) cannot be evaluated because no such translation exists. The only vector crypto code present covers Zvbc, Zvbb, Zvkned, Zvknh, Zvksh, Zvkg, and Zvksed — none of which involve Keccak operations.
